findings.motion: Release 'Chavez Approves $11 Billion Transportation Budget Passed by Ohio Senate' on his official Senate page
findings.note: His release, welcoming Senate passage of the transportation budget, says the budget keeps voter registration at the BMV in place on condition that the applicant shows proof of U.S. citizenship, and adds that citizenship is required to vote in Ohio. The sentence is narrative text, not a quotation of him; the fetch tool returned only part of it, so no verbatim passage is saved.
